rows.note: Use this as the most natural conversational way to say that something is bad for a particular person, body part, or purpose.

example.english: Eating so much spicy food is harmful to your stomach.
example.traditional: 食咁多辣嘢對個胃唔好。
example.jyutping: sik6 gam3 do1 laat6 je5 deoi3 go3 wai6 m4 hou2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose direct equivalent, especially in warnings or when the harmful effect is stated generally.

example.english: This chemical is harmful to the human body.
example.traditional: 呢種化學物質對人體有害。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 faa3 hok6 mat6 zat1 deoi3 jan4 tai2 jau5 hoi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for something harmful to the body or health, such as excessive drinking or unhealthy food.

example.english: Drinking so much alcohol is really harmful to your health.
example.jyutping: jam2 gam3 do1 zau2 zan1 hai6 soeng1 san1
